create.name: Leslie Kaminoff
create.bio:
Leslie Kaminoff is a New York yoga educator whose teaching grows out of the lineage of T. K. V. Desikachar, with its emphasis on breath and on fitting practice to the individual. Over more than forty years he has specialised in the anatomy of breathing and in bodywork, and he is best known as co-author, with Amy Matthews, of Yoga Anatomy, first published in 2007 and now in its third edition, with translations into many languages. He was also involved in the early national debates about standards for yoga teacher training, out of which grew his long-running e-Sutra blog and mailing list.

In 2001 he founded The Breathing Project, a non-profit that for many years ran a studio in Manhattan offering year-long anatomy courses for teachers. Those courses moved online in 2011 and are now gathered on his own learning platform, where students can join a low-cost monthly membership, take the Fundamentals anatomy course with Matthews, or work through the longer Principles and Practices courses, with a live question-and-answer call each month. He travels to teach workshops for schools and trainings in many countries, and offers private sessions on breath, movement and practice in person in Manhattan or on Cape Cod, and over Zoom. He sees his own style as a blend of rigour, spontaneity and humour.

courses.title: Fundamentals Solo
courses.description: An online anatomy course taught jointly with Amy Matthews, with lifetime access for one learner. It works through breathing mechanics, joints, the spine and movement, testing each idea in the student's own body, and meets the anatomy hours for Yoga Alliance trainings.

courses.title: Fundamentals Lifetime Access (for teacher trainings)
courses.description: A licensed version of the Fundamentals anatomy course that yoga schools can build into their own teacher trainings for all their students. Pricing is by enquiry.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Leslie Kaminoff
courses.description: One-to-one sessions on breath, posture and movement habits, held at his New York studio, on Cape Cod or over Zoom. A sliding fee applies, and first sessions are an hour long.
courses.price: Hour: sliding fee $190 – $250 USD; half-hour: $80 – $110 USD

free_resources.title: Become a Window Shopper (free membership)
free_resources.description: A free sign-up on his learning platform that opens a full lesson each from his Principles and Practices courses, a library of teaching videos and his weekly newsletter and blog.
